s: strI, (sarati gacCatIti । sf + ac । wAp .) nirJaraH । iti BaratadbirUpakozaH ॥ prasAriRI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: strI sf--ac । 1 prasAraRyAM rAjani॰ 2 nirJare dvirUpakozaH ।
m: सरा (आ), f. moving or wandering about, Gal.
स—राग mfn. having colour (sometimes = ‘not quite clean’), Kād.
enamoured, impassioned, passionate (अम् ind.), Kām.; Gīt.
a: सराग — a. 1 Coloured, tinged, tinted; (अकारि) सरागमस्या रसनागुणास्पदं Ku. 5. 10. --2 Dyed with red lac; R. 16. 15. --3 Impassioned, full of love, enamoured; मुनेरपि मनोऽवश्यं सरागं कुरुतेंऽगना Subhāṣ.

m: स—राग—ता f. (Pañcat.) the being coloured or flushed with passion, impassioned, redness, passion, love
स—राग—त्व n. the being coloured or flushed with passion, impassioned, redness, passion, love
स—राहु mfn. possessed or held by Rāhu (q.v.), eclipsed, BhP.
स—राजक mfn. (MBh.; f(इका). , Jātakam.) possessing a king, along with the king.
स—राजन् (KātyŚr.) mfn. possessing a king, along with the king.
स—राति (स-), mfn. equal in (bestowing) gifts, equally kind, RV.

s: puM, (sarAt saraRAt avatIti । ava rakzaRe + ac .) SarAvaH । iti BaratadvirUpakozaH ॥
v: pu॰ sara jalamavati ava--aR । 1 jalADAre mfRmaye pAtraBede(SarA)dvirUpakozaH । saha rAveRa । 2 saSabde tri॰
m: सराव m. a kind of venomous insect, Suśr.
a: सराव — a. Sounding, making a noise. --वः 1 A lid, cover. --2 A shallow dish, saucer; cf. शराव.

m: सराट N. of a place, Cat.
स—राष्ट्र or स—राष्˚ट्रक, mfn. possessing or along with a kingdom, MW.
